def starts_one_ends(n):
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    # For n-digit numbers, first digit can be 1 (9 choices for middle digits, 10^(n-2) total for middle digits)
    # Last digit can be 1 (9 choices for first digit, 10^(n-2) total for middle digits)
    # But we double count numbers that both start and end with 1
    # So: start_with_1 = 1 * 10^(n-1) (first digit 1, rest any digit)
    #     end_with_1 = 1 * 10^(n-1) (last digit 1, rest any digit)
    #     both = 1 * 10^(n-2) (first and last digit 1, middle any digit)
    #     total = start_with_1 + end_with_1 - both
    start_with_1 = 10 ** (n - 1)
    end_with_1 = 10 ** (n - 1)
    both = 10 ** (n - 2) if n > 1 else 0
    return start_with_1 + end_with_1 - both
